title: alpha-Mangostin Exhibits Antitumor Activity Against NCI-H1975 Cells via the EGFR/STAT3 Pathway: An Experimental and Molecular Simulation Study.
authors: Wang, Jing; Xian, Jiamin; Zhang, Ruohan; Wang, Zhuoyi; Zhang, Shuanggou; Zhao, Die; Sheng, Jun; Sun, Peiyuan
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过实验和分子模拟探讨α-倒捻子素经EGFR/STAT3通路抗非小细胞肺癌，分子对接对象为小分子-蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题无关。
abstract: Non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) harboring epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR) mutations have brought great challenges to the medical treatment in the world. Current treatment strategies, such as EGFR tyrosine kinase inhibitors (TKIs), have reached certain achievements, however, patients inevitably experienced resistance after undergoing a period of treatment with these drugs. Hence, more novel therapy strategies need to be urgently developed. Natural compounds have become popular topics in drug development. alpha-Mangostin, which is derived from mangosteen, possesses multiple biological properties, yet the antitumor mechanism against NSCLC has not been further elucidated. In this study, an MTT assay, Western blotting, a colony formation assay, and flow cytometry were performed to detect the antitumor activity of alpha-Mangostin on NSCLC cell NCI-H1975. Molecular docking and molecular dynamics simulations were performed to analyze the interactions between alpha-Mangostin and the core target proteins. The results indicated that alpha-Mangostin exerts its antitumor activity by inhibiting cell proliferation and migration, reducing cell cycle arrest, promoting cell apoptosis, and regulating the phosphorylation expression levels of EGFR and signal transducer and activator of transcription 3 (STAT3). Moreover, the results of the molecular simulation study revealed the potential binding mode of alpha-Mangostin to EGFR and STAT3. In summary, we characterized that alpha-Mangostin may be used as a potent pro-drug against NSCLC via the EGFR/STAT3 pathway.
abstract_zh: 携带表皮生长因子受体（EGFR）突变的非小细胞肺癌（NSCLC）给全球医疗治疗带来了巨大挑战。当前的治疗策略，如EGFR酪氨酸激酶抑制剂（TKIs），已取得一定成效，但患者在接受这些药物治疗一段时间后不可避免地产生耐药性。因此，亟需开发更多新颖的治疗策略。天然化合物已成为药物开发中的热门话题。α-倒捻子素（alpha-Mangostin）源自山竹果，具有多种生物活性，但其对NSCLC的抗肿瘤机制尚未进一步阐明。本研究采用MTT实验、Western blotting、集落形成实验和流式细胞术检测α-倒捻子素对NSCLC细胞NCI-H1975的抗肿瘤活性。通过分子对接和分子动力学模拟分析α-倒捻子素与核心靶蛋白之间的相互作用。结果表明，α-倒捻子素通过抑制细胞增殖和迁移、减少细胞周期阻滞、促进细胞凋亡以及调节EGFR和信号转导与转录激活因子3（STAT3）的磷酸化表达水平来发挥其抗肿瘤活性。此外，分子模拟研究结果揭示了α-倒捻子素与EGFR和STAT3的潜在结合模式。总之，我们表征了α-倒捻子素可能通过EGFR/STAT3通路作为针对NSCLC的有效前体药物。
